description.en: Amazon Quick (QuickWork) desktop chat agent over bidirectional WebSocket: reasoning, client tool calls, inline attachments, OAuth device login, and quota tracking.
description.zh: 通过双向 WebSocket 接入 Amazon Quick（QuickWork）桌面智能体：支持推理过程、客户端工具调用、图片附件、OAuth 设备码登录与用量查询。

description.en: Sign in with AWS Identity Center device authorization to unlock Amazon Quick agent models.
description.zh: 使用 AWS Identity Center 设备码登录以解锁 Amazon Quick 智能体模型。
